prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS1 temperature slope 0.381 °C/min (4% below healthy); TS2 mean temperature 41.2 °C (within 1% of healthy). Thermal characteristics align with nominal continuous cooling performance.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 10.1 s (3% above healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.69 s (4% above healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.39 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 404 W·min/l (5% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 54.7 % (7% below healthy). High power-to-flow ratio demonstrates extensive internal leakage across the pump chambers.
Accumulator: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.6 bar (2% above healthy). Pressure stability and surge dampening meet full design specifications.
